message: I remember the last blackout when my family and I were scrambling around the house like headless chickens. We found one flashlight that barely worked and a power bank with just enough charge to keep one phone alive. It was a comedy of errors, really! But we ended up cozying up together with some snacks and telling stories by the light of that dim flashlight. Now, I always keep a few extra power banks and a reliable lantern handy for next time. Have you ever been caught unprepared during a power outage?
